failureClasses.detail: Two pre-existing Bun servers and the test servers share port 8090. Requests reach unrelated app/auth instances, producing 18 HTTP 401 failures plus getUser 401 and refresh HTTP 400. Current client and server keys match.
The stderr fixture assumes bash/POSIX shell behavior and fails on Windows.

isolatedPortProbes.detail: On an OS-assigned port, signup, getUser, and refreshSession all succeeded against one server instance.
Isolation removes the misleading 401 and exposes HTTP 500: permission denied for table todos.
Isolation removes the misleading 401 and exposes HTTP 503: Supabase storage metadata schema is unavailable.
